title: Eric Davis saw classified crash-retrieval evidence with alien bodies
summary: Eric Davis tells of Eric Davis saw classified crash-retrieval evidence with alien bodies, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but I can tell you, yeah, it's a crash retrieval. There's a craft and there's alien bodies.

plain: A scientist named Eric Davis tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a case he says he knows of from secret material. In his words, it is a crash retrieval: there is a craft and there are alien bodies. If true, it would mean that non-human craft and their crews have been recovered.
